name: Lotion
definition: fluid leave-on moisturiser for any area.

name: Body oil
definition: oil applied to the skin to moisturise it or for massage.

name: Sleeping mask
definition: leave-on mask worn overnight.

name: Cotton pad
definition: pad of cotton or fibre for applying or removing skin-care products and makeup.

name: Foundation
definition: Tinted product that evens the colour of the face; cushion compacts are included.

name: Concealer
definition: high-coverage tinted product that hides spots, marks and shadows.

name: Blush
definition: coloured powder, cream or liquid that adds colour to the cheeks.

name: Primer
definition: product applied before makeup to prepare the skin for it.

name: Setting spray
definition: spray applied over makeup to fix it.

name: Skin paint
definition: powder or paint applied to the skin as colour, including kumkum and sindoor.

name: Mascara
definition: coloured product brushed onto the lashes.

name: Eyeliner
definition: pencil, liquid or gel that draws a line along the lash line.

name: Eyebrow gel
definition: tinted or clear gel that shapes and sets the brows.

name: False eyelashes
definition: strip or individual artificial lashes attached to the lash line.

name: Lash and brow serum
definition: leave-on serum applied to lashes or brows to condition them.

name: Makeup brush
definition: brush made for applying makeup.

name: Eyelash curler
definition: hand tool that clamps and curls the lashes.

name: Shampoo
definition: rinse-off product that washes the hair and scalp.

name: Conditioner
definition: rinse-off or leave-in product that softens and detangles hair after washing.

name: Hair mask
definition: intensive treatment left on the hair for a time and rinsed.

name: Hair dye
definition: product that changes the colour of the hair.

name: Hairspray
definition: spray that holds a hairstyle in place.

name: Wig
definition: full head covering of real or synthetic hair worn as hair.

name: Hairpiece
definition: partial piece of hair (extension, topper, fall) attached to the wearer's hair.

name: Flat iron
definition: heated plates that straighten hair by clamping it.

name: Curling iron
definition: heated barrel around which hair is wound to curl it.

name: Hair dryer
definition: appliance that blows heated air to dry hair.

name: Hot brush
definition: heated round or paddle brush that dries or styles hair.

name: Hairbrush
definition: brush with bristles or pins for brushing hair.

name: Comb
definition: toothed strip for combing and parting hair.

name: Hair tie
definition: plain elastic band that holds hair in place.

name: Hair clip
definition: plain clip or grip that holds hair, without jewels or ornament.

name: Solid perfume
definition: fragrance set in a wax or balm base, rubbed on the skin.

name: Perfume oil
definition: fragrance in an oil base with no alcohol, applied to the skin.

name: Hair perfume
definition: fragrance made to be sprayed on the hair.

name: Face cleanser
definition: rinse-off product made to wash the skin of the face.

name: Cleansing oil
definition: oil-based cleanser that dissolves makeup and sebum and emulsifies on rinsing.

name: Toner
definition: Watery leave-on product applied after cleansing to prepare the skin; toner pads are included.

name: Serum
definition: Concentrated leave-on treatment applied before moisturising; ampoules and essences are included.

name: Moisturising cream
definition: Thick leave-on moisturiser for the face, eyes, hands, feet or body.

name: Lip balm
definition: solid or soft balm with no colour that softens and protects the lips.

name: Sheet mask
definition: single-use sheet soaked in a treatment, laid on the face.

name: Sunscreen
definition: Product applied to the skin to protect it from UV, in any area and any form (stick, lotion, spray).

name: Insect repellent
definition: insect repellent applied to the skin.

name: Lipstick
definition: Coloured product applied to the lips; glosses and liquid lipsticks are included.

name: Nail polish
definition: coloured or clear lacquer painted on the nails.

name: Artificial nails
definition: press-on or glued nail tips or covers worn over the natural nail.

name: Alcohol-based perfume
definition: fragrance in an alcohol base, sprayed or splashed on the body.

name: Body mist
definition: light fragrance spray made for the body.

name: Straight razor
definition: single open blade that folds into its handle, honed and stropped by the user.

name: Shavette
definition: open-blade razor that holds a disposable blade.

name: Single-edge safety razor
definition: guarded razor holding a blade with one cutting edge.

name: Double-edge safety razor
definition: guarded razor holding a blade with two cutting edges.

name: Cartridge razor
definition: Razor with a handle that takes a multi-blade cartridge; disposable razors are included.

name: Shaving brush
definition: brush made for lathering soap or cream on the face.

name: Wet-shaving kit
definition: Starter set of razor, brush and shaving preparation sold as one item.

name: Electric shaver
definition: powered shaver with foil or rotary heads.

name: Hair clipper
definition: powered clipper that cuts head hair to a set length.

name: Beard trimmer
definition: powered trimmer made for beards and body grooming.

name: Tweezers
definition: hand tool that grips and plucks single hairs.

name: Shaving soap
definition: soap made to be lathered with a shaving brush, sold as a hard puck or tub, a soft soap (croap) or a shaving stick.

name: Shaving cream
definition: cream applied before shaving that lathers by hand or brush.

name: Aftershave
definition: Product applied to the skin after shaving; balms are included.

name: Body wash
definition: liquid bath and shower preparation for washing the body.

name: Bar soap
definition: bar of soap made for washing the body.

name: Wet wipe
definition: Moist wipe for cleaning the skin; baby wipes are included.

name: Deodorant
definition: Product that masks or reduces body odour, antiperspirants included; deodorant wipes are included.

name: Intimate wash
definition: wash made for external intimate hygiene.

name: Menstrual pad
definition: disposable or reusable pad worn to absorb menstrual flow.

name: Tampon
definition: absorbent plug inserted to absorb menstrual flow.

name: Menstrual cup
definition: reusable cup inserted to collect menstrual flow.

name: Personal lubricant
definition: lubricant applied to the intimate area.

name: Anal douche
definition: bulb or device for rinsing the rectum.

name: Potty
definition: small free-standing toilet bowl for a child.

name: Toilet-training seat
definition: child seat that fits on an adult toilet.

name: Changing mat
definition: padded mat on which a baby is changed.

name: Nappy
definition: disposable or cloth garment that absorbs a baby's urine and faeces.

name: Baby bath
definition: small tub made for bathing a baby.

name: Loofah
definition: natural or synthetic sponge or loofah sold for washing the body.

name: Pumice
definition: pumice stone sold for smoothing the skin.

name: Toothpaste
definition: paste or gel for cleaning the teeth.

name: Electric toothbrush
definition: powered toothbrush with an oscillating or vibrating head.

name: Grooming mirror
definition: Lit or magnifying mirror made for grooming; wall and dresser mirrors are in Decor.

name: Bathroom scale
definition: scale for weighing the body.

name: Nail clippers
definition: hand tool that cuts finger or toe nails.

name: Nail file
definition: file or emery board that shapes nails.

name: Manicure set
definition: Set of nail tools sold as one item.

name: Toiletry bag
definition: case made to carry toiletries.

name: Makeup bag
definition: case made to carry makeup.

name: Barber chair
definition: reclining, height-adjustable chair made for cutting hair and shaving.

name: Hot-water bottle
definition: sealed rubber or plastic bottle filled with hot water for warmth.

name: Massager
definition: Handheld or powered massager for comfort, including percussion and neck massagers.

name: Pacifier
definition: teat for a baby to suck that is not used for feeding.

name: Massage chair
definition: powered chair that massages the seated user.

name: Razor cartridge
definition: replaceable multi-blade cartridge for a cartridge razor.

name: Double-edge razor blade
definition: replacement blade with two cutting edges for a double-edge safety razor.

name: Single-edge razor blade
definition: replacement blade with one cutting edge for a single-edge safety razor.

name: Shaver head
definition: replacement foil, cutter or rotary head for an electric shaver.

name: Clipper guard
definition: attachment comb that sets the cutting length of a clipper or trimmer.

name: Toothbrush head
definition: replacement brush head for an electric toothbrush.

name: Hair dryer attachment
definition: nozzle or diffuser made to fit a hair dryer.

name: Razor strop
definition: Strip of leather or canvas (hanging, paddle or loom) on which the edge of a straight razor is realigned before shaving.

name: Pre-shave oil
definition: Oil, cream or gel applied to the beard before lathering to soften it and protect the skin.

name: Alum block
definition: block of potassium alum rubbed on wet skin after shaving as an astringent.

name: Styptic pencil
definition: stick of alum or other astringent pressed on a shaving nick to stop the bleeding.

name: Razor hone
definition: Fine sharpening stone or barber's hone for setting the edge of a straight razor; natural or synthetic, in different grits.

name: Strop paste
definition: abrasive paste or compound rubbed on a razor strop to polish the edge of a straight razor.

name: Teether
definition: ring, key or toy of silicone, rubber or wood made for a baby to chew to soothe teething gums.

name: Heat pack
definition: Reusable or single-use pack (gel, wheat or chemical) heated and laid on the body for warmth; neck warmers included.

name: Hand warmer
definition: small pouch or device held in the hand or pocket to warm it, chemical, reusable or rechargeable.

name: Manual toothbrush
definition: Toothbrush with a fixed head and no motor; baby and training brushes are included.

name: Water flosser
definition: powered device that cleans between teeth with a pulsed jet of water.

name: Menstrual disc
definition: flat flexible disc worn in the vaginal fornix to collect menstrual flow.

name: Exfoliator
definition: Rinse-off scrub or peel that removes dead skin from the face or body, with grains or acids.

name: Bath bomb
definition: compressed ball of bicarbonate, acid and scent that fizzes and dissolves in bath water.

name: Crimping iron
definition: heated ridged plates that press a zigzag wave into hair.

name: Hair-cutting scissors
definition: scissors made for cutting hair, thinning scissors included.

name: Hair roller
definition: Cylinder around which hair is wound to set curls; heated, velcro or foam.

name: Shaver cleaning cartridge
definition: fluid cartridge made for one maker's electric-shaver cleaning station.

name: Epilator
definition: powered device whose rotating tweezer discs pull hairs out by the root.

name: Multi-styler
definition: powered hot-air styler sold with interchangeable drying, curling and smoothing attachments.

name: Eyeshadow
definition: Coloured powder, cream or liquid applied to the eyelids; sold as palettes or singles.

name: Brow pencil
definition: pencil or powder that fills and shapes the eyebrows with colour.

name: Lip liner
definition: pencil that outlines the lips with colour.

name: Bronzer
definition: warm-toned powder or cream that adds a tanned colour to the face.

name: Face powder
definition: loose or pressed powder that sets makeup or mattifies the face.

name: Hair oil
definition: leave-in oil or oil serum applied to lengths and ends to condition and smooth hair.

name: Heat protectant
definition: spray or cream applied before heat styling to shield hair.

name: Bath salts
definition: mineral salt crystals, often scented, dissolved in bath water.

name: Wash-off face mask
definition: cream, clay, gel or peel mask spread on the face and rinsed off after a set time.

name: Self-tanner
definition: lotion, mousse, drops or spray that tans the skin without sun, usually by DHA.

name: Styling cream
definition: leave-in cream worked through hair to define, smooth or hold a style.

name: Face mist
definition: water-based spray misted onto the face to hydrate or refresh skin, over or under make-up.

name: Acne spot treatment
definition: paste, gel or cream dabbed on a single blemish to dry or calm it.

name: Pimple patch
definition: small hydrocolloid sticker worn over a blemish, plain or with an active ingredient.

name: Facial skin-care device
definition: Hand-held powered device for facial skin, such as a microcurrent, LED or cooling wand; a plain massager is listed under Comfort & massage.

name: Facial razor
definition: small single-blade razor for brows, peach fuzz and dermaplaning the face.

name: Highlighter
definition: shimmering powder, cream or liquid placed on the high points of the face to catch light.

name: Contour
definition: Cool-toned stick, cream, liquid or powder used to shade and sculpt the face; a warm bronzer is listed separately.

name: Makeup sponge
definition: sponge or blender used damp or dry to apply and blend foundation, concealer and cream products.

name: Leave-in conditioner
definition: conditioner in cream, milk, foam or spray form left in the hair after washing.

name: Detangling spray
definition: spray or lotion that loosens knots so wet or dry hair can be combed.

name: Scalp scrub
definition: exfoliating scrub with salt, sugar or grains massaged into the scalp before shampoo.

name: Scalp treatment
definition: Serum, tonic or acid treatment applied to the scalp (detox, soothing, oil control); minoxidil medicines are not included.

name: Dry shampoo
definition: powder or aerosol that absorbs oil at the roots without water.

name: Hair mousse
definition: foam styling product for volume, curl definition or light hold.

name: Hair gel
definition: gel styling product that sets hair or curls with firm hold.

name: Sea-salt spray
definition: spray giving grit, texture or beachy waves, with salt or polymers.

name: Volumizing spray
definition: spray applied at the roots of damp hair to lift and thicken before drying.
